locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Dot Property location paths, one per line: chonburi/pattaya, phuket, bangkok, prachuap-khiri-khan/hua-hin, chiang-mai. The path is the part of a Dot Property search link after condos-for-sale/.

propertyTypes.title: Property types
propertyTypes.description: Types of property to read in each location.

transactions.title: Sale and rent
transactions.description: Sale listings give prices; rent listings give rents and, together, the gross yield of each project.

maxPagesPerSearch.title: Max pages per search
maxPagesPerSearch.description: 30 listings per page. 0 reads every page. A partial read gives figures but cannot tell which listings left the market.

includeProjectDetails.title: Project details
includeProjectDetails.description: Read one listing page per project for its developer, completion year, floors, number of units and nearest landmark with its distance. Kept for 90 days, so later runs read only new projects.

maxProjectDetailsPerRun.title: Max project details per run
maxProjectDetailsPerRun.description: Projects with the most listings first; the rest are read in the next runs.

maxRemovalChecksPerRun.title: Max departure checks per run
maxRemovalChecksPerRun.description: A listing missing from the list pages since the last run is checked on its own page: gone or no longer on offer counts as left the market; still on offer means it was only missed. The rest are checked in the next run.

lotsFor.title: Find repeated units in
lotsFor.description: Deals in which to find the same unit listed by several advertisers.

maxNewPhotoHashesPerRun.title: Max new photos compared per run
maxNewPhotoHashesPerRun.description: Listings that may repeat a unit are compared by their first 4 photos (64×48 thumbnails, about 8 KB each). Comparisons are kept, so later runs read only new photos. The largest projects come first; the rest wait for the next runs.

saveListings.title: Save listings
saveListings.description: Save every listing as well as the project and district figures.

memoryName.title: Memory name
memoryName.description: Key-value store that keeps what earlier runs saw: first date and price of each listing, project details. Use one name per market you track.

concurrency.title: Parallel requests
concurrency.description: Requests at the same time. Keep it low: the Actor reads the site at a visitor's pace.

delayMs.title: Pause between requests (ms)
delayMs.description: Average pause before each request of each parallel reader.
